items.title: A $150,000 Patek for Me, and a Chrome Hearts Hoodie for My Teen
items.why: Ultra-luxury and streetwear spending sitting side by side in one household is a useful lens on affluent purchase behavior.
items.summary_ai: A Bloomberg column contrasts a $150,000 Patek watch with a Chrome Hearts hoodie bought for a teen.
items.take: Ultra-luxury and streetwear spending sitting side by side in one household is a useful lens on affluent purchase behavior.
